title.purpose: Console page titles — the only place the serif speaks large. Loaded via next/font as --font-playfair; ships as 1.875rem.

section-heading.purpose: In-section headers and card group titles. Panel/section headings unified at 1.25rem.

body.purpose: Default reading size for run sheets, lists, descriptions. Loaded via next/font as --font-dm-sans; all UI font sizes ship in rem (10px floor = 0.625rem). Numeric data uses tabular-nums.

label.purpose: Eyebrows and category markers — gold, uppercase, wide tracking.

login-display.purpose: Single hero line on login/setup screens. clamp(2.625rem,6vw,4.5rem), weight 500.

brand-serif.purpose: Sidebar wordmark and account monograms only (Georgia is system-loaded).

shadows.name: modal-veil
shadows.purpose: Dialogs floating above the page. Never on resting components.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for buttons/inputs hover and focus.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover lift (translateY -2px) + border shift to gold.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Primary action — the gilded entry. One per view where possible.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--restaurant-primary, #d7b46a); color: var(--restaurant-background, #231d0f); border: 1px solid var(--restaurant-primary, #d7b46a); font: 600 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(210,170,114,.16); }

components.name: Surface Button
components.description: Default quiet action — raised charcoal with a moss border.
components.css: .ds-btn-surface { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 11px; background: #202421; color: #e8e5dc; border: 1px solid #41473f; font: 600 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-surface:hover { background: #2a302b; border-color: #77765e; } .ds-btn-surface:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(210,170,114,.16); }

components.css: .ds-manager-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #343a34; border-radius: 14px; background: #171a18; color: #eee9df; text-decoration: none; transition: 0.16s; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-manager-card:hover, .ds-manager-card:focus-visible { border-color: #c6a06a; background: #1b211d; transform: translateY(-2px); outline: none; } .ds-gold-tile { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 11px; background: #d7b46a14; border: 1px solid #8d764866; } .ds-manager-card strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-manager-card p { margin: 0; color: #9ba198; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; flex: 1; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #d4b66d; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Compact text field — recessed dark well with a gold focus ring.

components.name: Active Tab
components.description: Segmented tab inside the pill strip — gold ink marks the selection.
components.css: .ds-tabstrip { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #343a34; background: #171a18; border-radius: 12px; width: max-content; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #9ba198; padding: 10px 17px; min-height: 42px; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab.ds-tab-active { background: #31372f; color: #e7c77f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #45483a; }

narrative.overview: A brass-bound ledger from a fine Levantine restaurant: dark paper, cream ink, and gold used only for the entries that matter. The interface is that ledger made operational — charcoal surfaces layered like stacked paper, sage-gray supporting text, and a single saffron-gold accent that behaves like gold ink: rare, deliberate, always marking something worth finding. Depth comes from tonal layering and 1px moss borders, never resting shadows. Dense and desktop-first, tuned for a manager reading fast in a back office. The system rejects fine-dining theatrics — no gold flooding, no ornate serif flourishes, no decorative gradients. Restraint is the brand.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (saffron gold), ≤10% of any screen, always functional
Tonal layering on a warm dark base; 1px moss borders do the separating
DM Sans carries data at 12–13px; serif only for brand voice
Hover = a small translateY lift, never a drop shadow
Material Symbols Outlined as the only icon system

rules.name: The Gilded Entry Rule
rules.body: Saffron gold appears only on things the manager must find or act on: the primary button, the active tab, the highlighted number, the back link. If gold covers more than ~10% of a screen, something is gilded that shouldn't be. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Lift, Don't Drop Rule
rules.body: Hover never adds a shadow. Affordance is a border-color shift toward gold plus a 1–2px translateY lift. Shadows are reserved for modals, focus rings, and the live dot.

dos: Do keep saffron gold rare and purposeful — primary actions, active states, highlights only
Do build depth with tonal layering (#111312 → #171a18 → #202421 → #31372f) and 1px moss borders
Do signal hover with a border shift toward gold plus a 1–2px translateY lift
Do center icons with inline-flex + gap, and give leading icons a fixed Gold Tile
Do pair focus rings with border-color changes: border-color:#d0ad64 + 0 0 0 2px #d0ad6428
Do use var(--restaurant-primary) for anything that follows manager branding
Do import Playfair Display and DM Sans via next/font — both are referenced but currently unload
donts: Don't reach for fine-dining theatrics — gold everywhere, ornate serif flourishes, decorative gradients (PRODUCT.md anti-reference)
Don't add side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) on cards, callouts, or alerts
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or backdrop-blur decoration
Don't drop shadows on resting components
Don't build the hero-metric template — KPI numbers are plain 700-weight cream
Don't rely on   or line-height:1 spans for icon alignment — use flex gap
Don't put white text on gold — on-saffron is #241b08
Don't invent one-off surface colors; step through the existing charcoal/slate ramp
